_comment: Example model-tier map. Point FG_TIERS at this file (or pass the JSON inline) to route roles -> tiers -> models. Every key is optional; omitted keys fall back to defaults (both tiers -> FG_MODEL, so a single-model setup needs no config at all). base_url/token are optional per tier for a multi-provider key pool; omit them to use the ambient ANTHROPIC_* environment.
